note: Informational only (D9): not a bench/run.sh product, no baseline, no bench/targets.json entry, never compared across fingerprints. What each of exec::Options' three planning knobs is worth on this machine, measured by running the SAME program with that one knob off. Every configuration at B=1, tile 256, lane_tile 8; baseline and knob-off captures run back to back in one alternating sequence so load drift cannot land on the contrast (D63 section 2(f): a first run that did not do this made Stage A look 0.65x FASTER with pairing off, uniformly including slot 4095, the output copy).

knob_sweep.units: microseconds per run, summed over every profile slot

pairing_ab.comment: The dedicated A/B for the one knob D63 was commissioned to price. slot 4095 (the output copy, which no interpreter option can touch) stayed at 0.61-0.64 us across all six captures except one 0.88 us outlier, which is this control's own noise floor.

stage_a_search_ladder.comment: Extracted estimate over the fully-paired default plan's estimate, E0, B=1, tile 256, lane_tile 8. 'before_D62' is the row D62 committed in egraph_scale.json, measured under the pre-D63 model; 'after_D63' is the same command under this entry's model. Both columns are cost-model ESTIMATES, not wall clock. The D63 history is shorter because the PLAN half collapsed into the empty root annotation: with infer_plan == default_plan, 'nothing decided' and the explicit reduction_fusion-then-fused_pairs chain are two spellings of one execution and tie exactly. Re-measured on the landed tree with the R2/adjoint package (89d2a45) present: byte-identical, which supersedes D67's absolute table (taken on aa6643d, before this entry's Lt fix) while confirming D67's zero-delta claim.
stage_a_search_ladder.verdict: Still noise: 0.5-1.0% sits well inside the model's own 49.7% mean relative error on the domains an optimisation decision turns on. cross_stage_wins remains 0.

prediction_error.comment: Mean absolute relative error, every measured domain / domains >= 1% of their config's time. Target < 25% (PROBLEM.md section 7). Rows 1-2 share D48's own 15 captures; rows 3-5 use the fresh 21-capture grid, so the 2->3 step mixes the grid change with a new measurement session.

ladder.fit: + pairing contrast in the grid, fresh 21 captures, scratch priced on byte_ns
+ the fit plans at the interpreter's real Lt = min(lane_tile, max_batch)

lane_tile_ab.comment: The Lt fix measured over IDENTICAL captures, two feature matrices, so machine load cannot enter the comparison. Stage A's own captures all have Lt == lane_tile and were never mis-planned; its share of the improvement is second-hand, which is the clearest evidence that the fit is joint.

model_vs_measured_knobs.comment: What the FINAL fitted model predicts for each knob-off contrast on the M1 book at the interpreter's real Lt=1, against what the knob sweep above measured. Before D63 the fuse_pairs row was 1.000x predicted by construction. This is the entry's own statement of what the model still cannot see.

m1_tie_break.comment: The specific tie that produced D54 experiment 1's reported 1.0 rediscovery ratio: the candidate it extracted (planner.reduction_fusion alone, non-empty domain, empty group, 0 pairings) against the fully-paired default plan, priced under the fitted model.

captures.comment: Every point of the committed grid is under bench/run.sh's own cores/2 = 8.0 bar; per-point loads are in costmodel_raw/index.json.
